shellCommands.command: for f in pages/_app.tsx pages/_document.tsx pages/index.tsx pages/about.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

sed -n '1,60p' 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md; echo "=====VERSION HISTORY page ====="; grep -n -A15 -i "version history" 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md
cd /workspace && git diff package.json | head -30 && echo "=== next-env ===" && ls -a | head -20
git rm -r --quiet pages && ls && echo "--- git status ---" && git status --short

(npm run start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/home.html && break; done; echo "=== HOME ==="; cat /tmp/home.html | head -c 1200; echo; echo "=== ABOUT ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/about | head -c 1200
pkill -f "next-server" ; pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore

git checkout tsconfig.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='tsconfig.json'
s=open(p).read()
old='"include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts"],'
new='"include": [\n    "next-env.d.ts",\n    "**/*.ts",\n    "**/*.tsx",\n    ".next/types/**/*.ts",\n    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"\n  ],'
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
git diff tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -18; echo "=== final tsconfig check ==="; git diff --stat tsconfig.json

(npm run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/d1.html && break; done
echo "HOME title: $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/d1.html)"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/about > /tmp/d2.html
echo "ABOUT title: $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/d2.html)"
echo "=== dev log errors ==="; grep -iE "error|warn|failed" /tmp/dev.log | head -10 || echo "(none)"
pkill -f "next dev"; pkill -f next-server; true
echo "=== final tree ==="; find app -type f | sort; echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
